BiblicalUsage: Sheleph was a son of Joktan, named in the table of nations in Genesis and again in Chronicles. His brothers are Almodad, Hazarmaveth, and Jerah, and his line runs to the peoples of Arabia.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the table of nations is the map of God's world. Sheleph's name is one line in it, and I hold that no nation is outside the Lord's sight.
